native_linker_optimization: Exact captured GNU LLD -O0/-O1/-O2/-O3 flags are retained verbatim as host-linker options, never inferred as harness or runtime compilation levels; joined -znow is also supported exactly
runtime_optimization: installed producer policy; not asserted to equal harness O1/O2

retention: Identical frozen selected native objects explicitly linked in both harnesses; --no-gc-sections
icf_policy: Every measured output, including default public-strong, is a native embedded LLD replay using --icf=none and --no-relax. Original Zig-driver links are unmeasured discovery artifacts only. Actual linker argv and exact producer versions are retained
bounded_subset: Optional --owned-member-limit N (1..2048) explicitly selects an ordinal-prefix subset BEFORE extraction and records available/selected counts; no automatic truncation or failure fallback. Full selected components above 2048 objects are unsupported unless the operator declares a bounded subset before measurement
ownership: Member receipts plus actual LLVM link-map winning-object adapter required for weak/hidden symbols
map_producer: Same installed Zig's embedded ld.lld 22.1.8 ALWAYS replays both final captured GNU argv from regular native-input snapshots with --icf=none/--no-relax. Only linked-artifact ownership requests append -Map; replay alone never enables weak/hidden ownership. Static -l tokens or pairs are replaced entirely by resolved snapshot paths. Both measured links share identical frozen dependency paths; owned object receipt paths stay unchanged. Before/after replay and publication SHA-256 checks cover source and consumed bytes. Original Zig-linked hashes are retained as explicitly unmeasured discovery evidence, never as consumed-byte proof. No executable lookup, cache guessing, fallback or synthesized maps
static_library_lookup: Bounded GNU static lookup collects all explicit joined/separate -L directories in recorded order, canonical against captured cwd, even when directories occur later in argv. Sequential -Bstatic/-Bdynamic/-static/--static state controls each -lfoo or -l:basename lookup; only static lookups are supported. First existing libfoo.a or exact safe simple basename must be a regular native archive or relocatable object, never a thin archive, shared image or linker script. Bitcode inside regular dependency archives is allowed without owned-member extraction. Search evidence, role, source/consumed paths and SHA-256 are retained. Dynamic/default lookup, missing inputs, sysroot substitution, scripts, start-lib and unsupported state/lookup forms are unsupported before measured replay. Limits: 256 search directories, 20000 resolved libraries/native inputs, 100000 argv words and 16 MiB argv text
measurement_tools: Parent freeze_measurement_tool captures evaluator and builder exactly once into run/tools BEFORE producer empty-directory validation. Original and captured paths/hashes are retained; all measurement commands use only captured paths with end-hash validation. The builder report evaluator_binary_sha256 binds the captured builder, not the separate inspection evaluator
command_environment: Real parent Commands(clean_environment=True) supplies the recorded configured-clean-allowlist-v1 environment and isolated run/configured-home before the first Zig/compiler call; inherited variables are removed, not merely omitted from receipts
owned_preflight: Before either final link/replay: 1..2048 owned objects, at most 256 MiB owned bytes, at most 1 MiB serialized JSON member receipts. Regular archives remain bounded to 512 MiB, members to 64 MiB, native input/member counts to 20000, total archive headers to 40000. Dependency-only archives are hashed and linked, never parsed under the selected component's native-member policy
notice_policy: Hash only the selected component notice and selected component/shared-header source inventory. Zig compiler-runtime LICENSE must match actual zig env lib_dir: ordinary unpacked zig.parent/lib with zig.parent/LICENSE, or Homebrew bin/zig with distribution lib/zig and zig.parent.parent/LICENSE. Never fall back to an unrelated parent LICENSE
publication_policy: Changed source or consumed native input/tool bytes reject publication without regrading or overwriting raw builder metrics; historical results remain provisional and are not upgraded by this policy
isolated_rust_component: --rust-sysroot consumes component-receipt.json. --rust-component-archive or receipt archive_path selects the pinned archive; fixed parent component_file_hashes verifies bounded archive payload bytes == receipt hashes == all materialized files before linking and publishing. Compiler-installed sysroot supplies original notices. Caller-reviewed hashes are not independent publisher authentication
member_ordinal_basis: object 0.40 ArchiveFile::members().enumerate(): zero-based after leading special tables; ordinary Rust metadata consumes an ordinal
truth_gate: Zero named truth is unsupported, never 100 percent recall
evaluation: Parent ELF/PE symbolized and stripped twin evaluator; Darwin unrun/unsupported
status: unrun; parent central build/test job budget only
